{
  "flores_passage": "Is sargarmi ko dekh kar, aabaad kaaron ne kumuk mangwayi thi. Colonel John Stark aur James Reed (baad azan donon generals muntakhab huye) ki sarbarahi mein, agli positions par muqami daston mein, 200 jawanon par mushtamil pehli aur teesri New Hampshire regiments shamil theen. Stark ke aadmiyon ne colonist ki jagah ki shumali had ke janglay par positions sambhaal lein. Jab jazeera numa ke shumal mashriqi hissay ke saath Mystic darya ke saath nasheebi lehar ne aik khala ko khol diya, unhon ne jaldi jaldi aik patthar ki chhoti deewar se janglay ko shumal ki jaanib wasee kiya jo aik chhote saahil par paani ke kinaare khatam hota tha. Gridley ya Stark ne janglay ke saamne taqreeban 100 foot (30 meter) ka khamba laga diya aur hukm diya ke jab tak aam size ki ashiya is se nahin guzar jaati koi fire nahin karega.",

  "mc_answer3": "Kam lahron ke dauraan",

}

{
  "flores_passage": "Nau-e-bashar ab tak ki sab se zyada zaheen makhlooq hai jo doosron ke zehan ko parh sakti hai. Is ka matlab yeh ke hum is qabil hain ke pesh-goi kar sakein ke doosre insaan kya darak karte, kya niyat karte, kya aqeeda rakhte, kya jaante aur kya chahte hain. In salahiyaton mein doosre ki niyat ko samajhna ahem hai. Yeh jismani aamaal ke mumkina abhamaon ko hal karne mein madad karti hai. Maslan agar aap kisi shakhs ko car ka sheesha tortay huye dekhte hain, to aap yahi farz karenge ke woh kisi ajnabi ki car chori karne ki koshish kar raha hai - hamein uske alag tarah se sochna hoga ke shayad un ki gaari ki kunji kho gayi hai aur yeh uski apni hi car thi jise woh torne ki koshish kar raha tha -",
  "question": "Passage ke mutabiq niyat ko samajhne se insaan ko kya karne mein madad milti hai?",
  "mc_answer1": "Jismani harkaat ke baad ghair-yaqeeni soorat-e-haal ko khatam karna",
  "mc_answer2": "Khwahishat ki pesh-goi karna",
  "mc_answer3": "Doosre insaanon ko baghair kisi faisle ke hi dekhna",
  "mc_answer4": "Doosron ki soch ko samajhna"
}

{
  "flores_passage": "Bahut se logon ka mushahida hai ke felyaat aur bartao mein taal aksar circadian chakkar aur hayatiyati clocks ke zariye un ki paidawar ki maujoodgi par munhasir karti hai.
